ADDED i3: A Value built from a property-name array; the resulting Value keeps the default flags (no ignoreUnknown, no allowGetters/Setters) but does enable merge.
ADDED i4: mergeAll ignores the null slots and merges the two Values it finds.
ADDED i5: The flags from allFlagsEnabled are OR-ed into the merged result.
ADDED i6: The merge also carries over the ignored property name, so the result is neither equal to nor the same instance as the all-flags input.
